setup.heading: Set the DM PIN
setup.intro: The PIN protects the DM view. You set it once, here on the server PC, and enter it on any browser you run the game from.
setup.pin: PIN, 4 to 8 digits (6 to 8 are much harder to guess)
setupElsewhere.heading: Set up on the server PC
setupElsewhere.body: No DM PIN has been set yet. Open the DM view in a browser on the PC that runs the server to set it.
signIn.heading: Enter the DM PIN
signIn.sessionEnded: You were signed out: the server restarted, or the PIN was changed or this browser was signed out elsewhere. Enter the PIN to continue.
signIn.lockedOut: Too many wrong PINs. Try again in {wait}.
signIn.paused: PIN entry is paused on every device except the server PC, after many wrong PINs on this network, not necessarily from this device. Try again here in {wait}, or on the server PC open {address}
workspace.noSceneHint: Choose a scene in the scene list, or a session with the switcher at the top.

scene.nothingToUndo: Nothing to undo on the live scene.
scene.tvSteered: The TV now shows the part of the map in the frame.
scene.tvFitted: The TV now shows the whole map.
scene.tvFailed: The TV's view was not changed. {reason}
scene.tvOffline: Not connected: the TV's view was not changed. Try again once the connection is back.
scene.undoOffline: Not connected: nothing was undone. Try again once the connection is back.
scene.undoStale: That change can no longer be undone, so it was skipped. Ctrl+Z again undoes the change before it.
scene.undoFailed: The last change could not be undone. {reason}
scene.pingFailed: The ping was not shown on the TV. {reason}
scene.pingOffline: Not connected: the TV does not show this ping. Ping again once the connection is back.
scene.rulerFailed: The measurement was not shown on the TV. {reason}
scene.rulerOffline: Not connected: the TV does not show this measurement. Measure again once the connection is back.

connect.heading: Connect a screen
connect.loading: Finding the addresses of this PC…
connect.intro: On the TV, open the web browser and type this address, or scan the code with a phone.
connect.adapterChosen: Network adapter: {adapter}. Chosen as the TV address in Settings.
connect.chosenMissing: The TV address chosen in Settings, {address}, is not an address of this PC now, so the one found automatically is shown. Choose Automatic in Settings to stop seeing this.
connect.cannotOpen: If the TV cannot open it, check first that Windows calls this Wi-Fi a private network (Settings, Network & internet). Then choose the right address as the TV address in Settings.
connect.othersHint: If the TV is on another network, try one of these.
connect.none: This PC has no network address. Connect it to the Wi-Fi the TV uses, then open this panel again.
settings.heading: Settings
settings.loadFailed: The settings could not be read. {reason}
settings.uploadLimitInvalid: Enter a whole number of MB from {min} to {max}.
settings.displaySize: Display size for the TV, in pixels
settings.displaySizeHint: The longest side, in pixels, of the copy of each map and token image that screens show. From {min} to {max}; smaller loads faster on a TV.
settings.displaySizeInvalid: Enter a whole number of pixels from {min} to {max}.
settings.tvAddressMissing: {address}, not an address of this PC now
settings.tvAddressHint: The address Connect a screen and its QR code use. Keep Automatic unless the TV cannot open it. Then choose your Wi-Fi's address: Windows shows it as the IPv4 address of your network (Settings, Network & internet).
settings.limitsHint: Larger images are refused, and so are exports larger than the import limit or that unpack to more. Upload 1 to {upload} MB; import 1 to {import} MB.
settings.importLimitInvalid: Enter a whole number of MB from {min} to {max}.
settings.savedRegenerating: Settings saved. Images are being resized in the background; the TV switches to each new size when it is ready.
settings.pinIntro: Changing the PIN signs out every other browser signed in to the DM view. A PIN of 6 to 8 digits is much harder to guess. Wrong PINs here count towards the same limits as signing in.
settings.pinChanged: PIN changed. Other browsers were signed out.
settings.pinPaused: PIN changes are paused on every device except the server PC. Try again in {wait}, or on the server PC open {address}
sceneMap.image: Map image: PNG, JPEG or WebP
sceneMap.replaceImage: New map image: PNG, JPEG or WebP
sceneMap.replaceHint: A new map starts with its own grid, and the current image is deleted if nothing else uses it.
sceneMap.tooLarge: This file is {size} MB; the upload limit is {limit} MB.
sceneMap.loadFailed: The map image could not be loaded. Reload the page, or replace the map.
sceneMap.replaceCalibrated.heading: Replace the map?
sceneMap.replaceCalibrated.body: This scene's grid is calibrated to the current map. The calibration goes with it: the new map starts with its own grid.
sceneGrid.feetInvalid: Enter a number of feet from {min} to {max}.
sceneGrid.feetRestored: Feet per square must be from {min} to {max}, so it stays {feet}.
calibration.heading: Calibrate the grid
calibration.hint.dimensions: The map is this many squares across and down. Check in the magnified far corner that the lines sit on the drawn ones.
calibration.hint.rectangle: Drag a rectangle on the map from corner to corner of {squares} × {squares} drawn squares.
calibration.hint.fine: In pixels of the original image. Up and down arrows change a value by 0.1, with Shift by 1.
calibration.result: {size} px squares, first lines at x {x}, y {y}; {columns} × {rows} squares.
calibration.error.count: Enter a whole number of 1 or more.
calibration.error.size: That square size is too small to draw on this map.
calibration.magnifier: Far corner of the map, magnified, with the grid
calibration.magnifierLoading: Loading the far corner from the original image…
calibration.magnifierFailed: The original image could not be loaded, so the far corner cannot be shown.
canvas.label: Map of {name}
canvas.labelLive: Live map of {name}: every change shows on the TV
canvas.labelOffline: Live map of {name}, not connected: changes are not reaching the TV
canvas.help: On the map: arrow keys pan, + and − zoom, 0 fits the map; hold Space and drag to pan, scroll to zoom. V selects, M measures, T adds a token.
canvas.helpMeasure: Drag on the map from corner to corner to measure. Arrow keys pan, + and − zoom, 0 fits the map; scroll to zoom.
canvas.helpPlace: Click on the map where the token goes; hold Alt to place it off the grid. On the map, Enter places it at the centre of the view and Escape cancels.
canvas.helpToken: {label} is selected: arrow keys move it a square, Delete deletes it, Escape lets it go. Drag a token to move it; hold Alt while dropping to place it off the grid.
canvas.helpLive: On the map: arrow keys pan, + and − zoom, 0 fits the map; hold Space and drag to pan. The frame named What the TV shows is the TV's view: drag its edge to move it or a corner to zoom it, or use the TV camera buttons above the map.
canvas.helpRuler: Measuring, seen only by you: this scene is not live. Drag on the map from one square to another; drag with the right or middle button to pan. On the map, arrow keys move the end a square (Shift moves the whole ruler), Enter starts again at the centre of the view, + and − zoom; Escape clears, and M or Escape again stops measuring.
canvas.helpFog: Fog brush: drag on the map to paint fog, or to erase it when erasing; a right-button drag pans. On the map, Enter paints at the centre of the view, E switches painting and erasing, [ and ] make the brush smaller and larger, arrow keys pan; Escape drops the stroke under way, and F or Escape again stops painting.
canvas.helpPing: Pinging on the live scene: click the map to mark a point on the TV and here for two seconds; drag to pan. On the map, Enter pings the centre of the view, arrow keys pan, + and − zoom; P or Escape stops pinging.
canvas.pingLiveOnly: Pings show on the TV, so they work on the live scene only.
canvas.helpRulerLive: Measuring on the live scene: the TV shows the line and the distance. Drag on the map from one square to another; drag with the right or middle button to pan. On the map, arrow keys move the end a square (Shift moves the whole ruler), Enter starts again at the centre of the view, + and − zoom; Escape clears, and M or Escape again stops measuring.
canvas.helpRulerShown: A measurement is shown: Escape on the map clears it, and M measures again. Arrow keys pan, + and − zoom, 0 fits the map.

tokens.picker.empty: The library has no assets yet. Add one in the library first.

tokens.renameDialog.label: Label

assetForm.replaceImage: New image, if it changes: PNG, JPEG or WebP
assetForm.tooLarge: This file is {size} MB; the upload limit is {limit} MB.
assetForm.name: Name
assetForm.hidden: Tokens of this asset start hidden
assetDelete.heading: Delete {name}?
assetDelete.intro: This is permanent. Its image goes too if nothing else uses it.
assetDelete.inUse: {name} is used by tokens on these scenes, so it cannot be deleted:
error.heading: Something went wrong
error.body: This view stopped working. Reloading it keeps everything the server has saved.
error.code.not_found: That item no longer exists. It may have been deleted from another browser.
error.code.validation_failed: The server refused what was entered. Check the values and try again.
error.code.malformed_body: The server could not read the request. Reload the page and try again.
error.code.bad_request: The server refused the request. Reload the page and try again.
error.code.unsupported_media_type: Only PNG, JPEG and WebP images are accepted.
error.code.payload_too_large: The file is larger than the upload limit.
error.code.command_unsupported: The server does not support that action.
error.code.internal_error: Something went wrong on the server. Try again; the server log has the details.
error.code.unauthorized: This browser is no longer signed in. Enter the PIN again.
error.code.forbidden: This action is only allowed from the server PC.
error.code.locked_out: Too many wrong PINs. Wait a while and try again.
error.code.pin_paused: PIN entry is paused on every device except the server PC, after many wrong PINs on this network. Use a browser on the server PC, or wait a while and try again.
error.code.pin_not_set: No DM PIN has been set yet.
error.code.pin_already_set: A DM PIN has already been set. Enter it to sign in.
error.code.reference_not_found: Something this refers to no longer exists. Reload and try again.
error.code.order_mismatch: The list changed in another browser. It has been reloaded; try again.
error.code.confirmation_mismatch: What this deletes has changed. Check again before deleting.
error.code.asset_in_use: This asset is used by tokens and cannot be deleted.
error.code.calibration_needs_map: A scene without a map has no grid to calibrate. Attach a map first.
error.code.scene_live: This scene is live. Its tokens change only in live mode.
error.code.scene_not_live: This scene is no longer live, so the change was not made.
error.code.import_busy: Another import is running. Wait for it to finish, then try again.
error.code.import_too_large: This file is larger than the import limit in Settings, or unpacks to more than it.
error.code.import_newer_format: This file was made by a newer Emberglass; update to import it.
error.code.import_unsafe_entry: This file holds something an Emberglass export never holds, so it was refused.
error.code.import_invalid: This file is not an Emberglass export this server can read, or it is damaged.
error.code.import_image_refused: An image in this file is not a PNG, JPEG or WebP image an upload would accept, or it is damaged.
error.code.network: The server did not answer. Check that it is running and try again.

initiative.label: Initiative
initiative.notLive: Combat runs on the live scene. Put this scene on the TV to start it.
initiative.intro: Roll initiative at the table, then start combat: every player character, monster and npc the players can see gets a row.
initiative.addDead: A Dead monster takes no turn
initiative.passed: Passed over: players cannot see it
initiative.numberHint: Type a number, or scroll over the field to raise or lower it.
initiative.endDialog.heading: End combat?
initiative.endDialog.body: The turn order and the round are cleared. Undo brings them back only until another scene goes live or the server restarts.

hp.entryInvalid: Type −7, +5 or a whole number up to 9999.
hp.noCurrent: {label} has no hit points to change. Set them first.

shortcuts.noteFollow: The TV follows your view as you pan and zoom.

assets.statsInvalid: Max HP is 1 to 9999 and AC 0 to 99, or leave them empty.

import.heading: Import
import.intro: Choose an Emberglass export: a campaign or library assets. A campaign is added as a new copy; assets and images this server already has are reused, never changed. If the file is refused, nothing changes.
import.refused.newer: This file was made by a newer Emberglass (format {version}); update to import it.
